def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in g))
    # Isolated interior color is the color of the ray; boundary bars provide ray origins.
    counts={}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v!=bg and (r not in (0,h-1) and c not in (0,w-1)):
                counts[v]=counts.get(v,0)+1
    fill=max(counts, key=counts.get) if counts else 1
    rays=[]
    def runs(vals):
        i=0
        while i<len(vals):
            j=i+1
            while j<len(vals) and vals[j]==vals[i]: j+=1
            if vals[i]!=bg and j-i>=2:
                rays.extend((i+k, vals[i]) for k in range(j-i))
            i=j
    # Each run on a border launches perpendicular rays inward.
    for r in (0,h-1):
        vals=g[r]
        i=0
        while i<w:
            j=i+1
            while j<w and vals[j]==vals[i]: j+=1
            if vals[i]!=bg and j-i>=2:
                for c in range(i,j):
                    rays.append(('v',r,c))
            i=j
    for c in (0,w-1):
        vals=[g[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        i=0
        while i<h:
            j=i+1
            while j<h and vals[j]==vals[i]: j+=1
            if vals[i]!=bg and j-i>=2:
                for r in range(i,j): rays.append(('h',r,c))
            i=j
    for item in rays:
        if item[0]=='v':
            _,r,c=item; step=1 if r==0 else -1
            rr=r+step
            while 0<=rr<h:
                if g[rr][c]==fill:
                    g[rr][c]=4; break
                g[rr][c]=fill
                rr+=step
        else:
            _,r,c=item; step=1 if c==0 else -1
            cc=c+step
            while 0<=cc<w:
                if g[r][cc]==fill:
                    g[r][cc]=4; break
                g[r][cc]=fill
                cc+=step
    return g
PY

def _runs(values, bg):
    out=[]
    i=0
    while i<len(values):
        j=i+1
        while j<len(values) and values[j]==values[i]: j+=1
        if values[i]!=bg and j-i>=2: out.append((i,j,values[i]))
        i=j
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    left=_runs([g[r][0] for r in range(h)],bg)
    right=_runs([g[r][-1] for r in range(h)],bg)
    top=_runs(g[0],bg)
    bottom=_runs(g[-1],bg)
    protected=set()
    # Prefer a pair of opposite vertical-edge bars, then horizontal-edge bars.
    if left and right and left[0][2]==right[0][2]:
        a,b=left[0],right[0]
        n=min(a[1]-a[0],b[1]-b[0])
        protected.update((r,0) for r in range(a[0],a[1]))
        protected.update((r,w-1) for r in range(b[0],b[1]))
        marks=[]
        for r in range(a[0],a[0]+n):
            for c in range(1,w-1):
                if g[r][c]!=bg: marks.append((r,c,g[r][c],0,r-a[0]))
        for r in range(b[0],b[0]+n):
            for c in range(1,w-1):
                if g[r][c]!=bg: marks.append((r,c,g[r][c],1,r-b[0]))
        if marks:
            for r,c,color,side,k in marks:
                mate=(b[0] if side==0 else a[0])+k
                if side==0:
                    for cc in range(1,c): g[r][cc]=color
                else:
                    for cc in range(c+1,w-1): g[r][cc]=color
                # paired lane fills to the edge, but never overwrites its bar
                for cc in range(w):
                    if (mate,cc) not in protected: g[mate][cc]=color
            for r,c,*_ in marks:g[r][c]=4
            return g
    if top and bottom and top[0][2]==bottom[0][2]:
        a,b=top[0],bottom[0]
        n=min(a[1]-a[0],b[1]-b[0])
        protected.update((0,c) for c in range(a[0],a[1]))
        protected.update((h-1,c) for c in range(b[0],b[1]))
        marks=[]
        for c in range(a[0],a[0]+n):
            for r in range(1,h-1):
                if g[r][c]!=bg: marks.append((r,c,g[r][c],0,c-a[0]))
        for c in range(b[0],b[0]+n):
            for r in range(1,h-1):
                if g[r][c]!=bg: marks.append((r,c,g[r][c],1,c-b[0]))
        if marks:
            for r,c,color,side,k in marks:
                mate=(b[0] if side==0 else a[0])+k
                if side==0:
                    for rr in range(1,r): g[rr][c]=color
                else:
                    for rr in range(r+1,h-1): g[rr][c]=color
                for rr in range(h):
                    if (rr,mate) not in protected: g[rr][mate]=color
            for r,c,*_ in marks:g[r][c]=4
            return g
    return g
